title: A Gold layer that stays in Direct Lake
objectives: Build Gold as tables, not views, so Direct Lake reads them directly
Point every fact row at a dimension, using an unknown member when needed
Choose the grain and types a report needs

exercises.prompt: Build the table gold_daily_sales from silver_sales: sold_on DATE, product_key INTEGER and revenue DECIMAL(12, 2), one row per day and product. Every product_key must be in dim_product; sales of a product code it doesn't know go to the Unknown member (-1). End with SELECT * FROM gold_daily_sales ORDER BY sold_on, product_key.
hints: The starter makes a view, which Direct Lake can't read directly: the model would fall back to DirectQuery.
LEFT JOIN dim_product on product_code, and coalesce(d.product_key, -1) for codes it doesn't have.
CREATE TABLE gold_daily_sales (sold_on DATE, product_key INTEGER, revenue DECIMAL(12, 2)); then INSERT ... GROUP BY sold_on, coalesce(d.product_key, -1).
